name: Amarasundari Rasa

sections.introduction: Amarasundari rasa is one of the effective ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This formulation is known to treat the problems related to vata dosha.
sections.ingredients:
Sonth – Zingiber officinale 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Amla – Phyllanthus emblica 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Bahera – Terminalia bellirica 
 Renuka – Vitex Negundo 
 Pippali moola – Piper longum’s root 
 Chitraka moola bark – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Loha bhsama – Calcined iron 
 Dalchini – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Tejpatta – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Nagkesar – Mesua ferrea 
 Chotti iliachi – Elettaria cardamomum (small) 
 Shuddha parad – Purified and processed mercury 
 Shuddha gandhaka – Purified sulfur 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Akarakara – Anacyclus pyrethrum 
 Nagarmotha – Cyperus rotundus 
 Suddha bachnag – Aconitum ferox 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the ingredients up to one-one gram and mix with jaggery syrup. 
 Prepare the paste and make pills from this paste. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 It is poly herbal Ayurvedic formulation which is made using different herbal ingredients. It has ability to balance the vata dosha and their related disorders. It is useful in case of respiratory problem like cough, cold and asthma. Use of this medicines is useful in case of digestive problems also like piles, anal fistula, bloating of abdomen and indigestion. It improves the digestive functions and helps to clear channels. Apart from these it is useful in case of brain disorders like paralysis, epilepsy, schizophrenia. In case of epilepsy, it is helpful in the management of symptoms associated with disease like lack of consciousness, dizziness, tingling and twitching of limbs. It helps to improve the functions of muscles thus it is useful in case of paralysis and Bell’s palsy. Amarasundari Rasa is useful to improve the general weakness and fatigue. Balances overall all the vitiated doshas to provide good health.
